pieces.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: top-down B-roll still for video editing and thumbnails. Scene: blank white documents, a plain kraft folder, metal paper clips and an uncapped black pen arranged on a pale oak table. Style: photorealistic editorial flat lay. Composition: 16:9 landscape, exact overhead view, 50mm lens, organized asymmetry and usable negative space. Lighting: diffuse daylight from the upper left, neutral 5100K, soft paper shadows. Materials: uncoated paper, kraft card, brushed steel and pale oak grain. Constraints: every sheet must be blank, no people, no hands, no faces, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no signatures, no logos, no brands, no watermark.
